_how_to: Public values only. No secrets. enabled stays false until the Worker is deployed and turnstile_sitekey is set, then the site is rebuilt. While enabled is false, /tip/ shows an opening-soon notice and no form. endpoint is the Worker URL the form posts to. turnstile_sitekey is the public Turnstile site key. onion is http://<56-char>.onion once the VPS has generated it, or empty. The Onion-Location meta tag is emitted only when onion is set.
